title: Integrate run history and navigation with accessible slide-out drawers
description: Provide a left slide-out history drawer for optimization runs/interactive sessions and edition history, scoped to selected scorecard with search/filter and active/inspected distinction. Keep it closed during focused labeling by default; do not permanently consume labeling width. Provide app-level navigation accessible at narrow sizes, deep links and browser back/forward preserving selected scorecard/run/view. Drawer opening is local UI state, not a run mutation; retain current item, pending job and unsaved comments/labels on close or navigation cancellation. Focus management, Escape, backdrop dismissal, accessible names and touch targets. Acceptance: open history, inspect another run, return to active session with drafts intact; tablet overlay never obscures unreachable dismiss/actions; inactive editions clearly read-only until explicitly activated.

comments.author: home
comments.text: History now uses a dismissible left drawer instead of permanent side column. Selecting a run or creating a run closes drawer; current item remains mounted while opening/closing it. Remaining: scorecard-scoped filtering/search, proper browser back/forward and preservation of drafts when switching runs.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Added browser back/forward route restoration, run-name search and scorecard filtering. Unsent multi-classifier labels and explanations persist per immutable prediction presentation in session storage; unavailable/malformed storage does not block labeling. New-run setup moved from inline cards to a dismissible right drawer; browser checked Create run reachable at 720px height, closing returns to unchanged live item. Remaining: selected scorecard deep links, edition read-only distinction, tablet and keyboard acceptance across run switching.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Selected scorecard now has a scorecard=<id> deep link. WebApp preserves this routing parameter and browser Back restores the selected card; tested in components and live Anthus browser. No configuration changes, human labels, or model calls were produced by navigation. Remaining: inspected revision deep links, inactive-edition read-only distinction and tablet/keyboard cross-run draft acceptance.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed presentation-scoped label drafts in the reusable hook: changing presentation without remounting no longer exposes or persists another items labels/comments, and delayed old-presentation callbacks are ignored. Regression watched fail first; hook, reviewer, and WebApp tests now cover item switching and replay inspection/browser-history return preserving unsent vote plus explanation without any API mutation. Session-storage failure remains non-blocking. Actual tablet/keyboard acceptance and browser-native cross-run testing still remain; this does not close the full drawer story.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Correction-drawer draft preservation improved: closing/reopening and switching reviewed items retain independent unsaved labels/explanations with their original expected feedback IDs. Completing a correction removes only that items draft, preserving other item drafts. Two regressions failed first, then 145 UI tests and build passed. Browser verified isolated offline fixture close/reopen and item-switch retention with reachable Save and no console errors; no correction was submitted and no real labels/model calls changed. Corrected stale docs claiming editor was absent. Correction editor drafts remain in-memory across drawer navigation, not reload/run departure; that broader durability remains open.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Correction drafts now persist through reload, run departure/return and timeline navigation in validated browser session storage scoped by run, using the shared session-draft hook also used by labeling. Original expected feedback identities remain unchanged. Concurrent saved-vote changes disable Save while retaining intent; Discard draft and load saved feedback explicitly resets to current evidence. Malformed/unavailable storage is non-blocking and old-run callbacks cannot edit a new run. 150 UI tests and build passed; focused lint has only the existing external-job synchronization effect warning. Offline browser verified reload and timeline round-trip retained explanation, reachable Save, no console errors, and no submitted corrections or model work. Screenshot var/web/durable-correction-draft-proof.jpg. Broad tablet/keyboard drawer acceptance remains open.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Keyboard acceptance found and fixed real shared UI gaps: narrow menu was hand-built aria-modal without focus trapping/background hiding; replaced with Radix modal while retaining descriptive full-viewport navigation, current-workspace aria-current and branding. AppDrawer external openers did not regain focus after Escape; now explicitly captured/restored when connected. Regression failures observed before fixes. 153 UI tests/build and focused new-component lint pass. Offline browser confirmed Tab/Shift+Tab wrapping, Escape focus return for menu and correction drawer, no console errors, no votes/model work. Broad run/edition/tablet timeline acceptance still open.
